abstract: Maintains automated visual inspection and defect rejection performance records
system_message:
You are the Optical Inspection Engineering Lead (OPT), responsible for maintaining automated visual inspection and defect rejection performance records as well as false reject monitoring data across contract manufacturing partner facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: False reject monitoring（REJEC）
information_points.content:
OPT-REJEC-38U：During automated inspection setup using clear glass vial test batches, the high-speed camera calibration logbook recorded an optical false reject rate of 1.25 % for Apex BioFormulations Facility.
OPT-REJEC-9LZ：High-speed camera calibration logbook evaluations across clear glass vial test batches during automated inspection setup showed an optical false reject rate of 0.35 % for Meridian Parenteral Works.
OPT-REJEC-5DJ：Calibration logbook records for clear glass vial test batches during automated inspection setup show that Vanguard Sterile Solutions logged an optical false reject rate of 0.75 %.

information_points.title: Maintains automated visual inspection and defect rejection performance records（INSPEC）
information_points.content:
OPT-INSPEC-YPU：According to the post-filling optical inspection summary for the final batch validation run of ten thousand sealed vials, Apex BioFormulations Facility recorded an automated visual inspection defect rate of 1.5 % rejected for particulate matter or cosmetic container closure defects.
OPT-INSPEC-O7V：Based on the post-filling optical inspection summary evaluated during the final batch validation run of ten thousand sealed vials, Vanguard Sterile Solutions demonstrated an automated visual inspection defect rate of 2.4 % rejected for particulate matter or cosmetic container closure defects.
OPT-INSPEC-K65：Post-filling optical inspection data from the final batch validation run of ten thousand sealed vials indicates that Meridian Parenteral Works achieved an automated visual inspection defect rate of 1.2 % rejected for particulate matter or cosmetic container closure defects.
